race.comment: ZEE HOUTEN (3) was well held at Cranbourne, yet her previous maiden win at Riverina Paceway as a well-supported favourite gives her a strong rebound case. Big chance from a good draw. MAGIC BULLSEYE (7) has a sharp time profile, especially the 1 WIN fourth at Riverina Paceway when beaten just over three metres in a 1:53.4 mile rate, though the second row makes the task less straightforward. NAMELLA (4) returns second-up after being beaten just over nine metres in an NR up to 53 at Riverina Paceway and has enough ratings depth to press for a placing if sharper. VERY BOUTIQUE (2) will be fitter third up and draws well so may improve.
